name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior gold explorer and royalty holder focused on properties in Nevada, one of the world's top-rated gold mining jurisdictions. The company holds stream and royalty interests, including the Lapon Canyon Gold Project where significant intercepts of 3.97 g/t Au over 85 metres were reported in early 2026. The company operates with minimal overhead as it does not directly fund capital or exploration costs on its royalty properties.
